title: Exclusive-Indian consumer regulator escalates probe into Apple's software warranty terms
summary: NEW DELHI, Sept 15 (Reuters) - India's consumer regulator is examining Apple's software warranty terms in an investigation of the iOS 18 update alleged to have damaged iPhone functionality, compelling users to pay "exorbitant" sums for repairs, documents show. The sparring is shaping as Apple's latest headache in ‌a growth market where it is fast expanding iPhone manufacturing and rapidly growing market share, but also fending off accusations of breaching domestic antitrust laws.
